injected_fault.name: error-burst
injected_fault.mechanism: StatefulSet insighthub-deps-redis scaled to 0 (Redis is emptyDir, queue/results only). /readyz checks only the DB so the API stays in rotation, POST /documents fails to enqueue and returns HTTP 500 (probed: 500 in 7 ms), and the ingestion-worker cannot reach Redis and restarts. 90 unique uploads, one per 3s. Recovery: StatefulSet scaled back to 1, chaos-* documents deleted.

injected_fault_evaluation.verdict: correct on root cause, imprecise on mechanism
injected_fault_evaluation.detail: The blind investigator identified that Redis was unavailable from 20:07:17Z to 20:11:35Z (redis_up 1 -> 0 -> 1, matching the script), that the 5xx ratio (peak 0.497) came only from /documents, that the worker lost its consumer and restarted (6 restarts, availability 0) and that pending documents piled up, and it ruled out Postgres, an api rollout and a slow LLM provider with harvested samples. Imprecision: it described the Redis pod as deleted and recreated, whereas the StatefulSet was deliberately scaled to 0 (the 4 min 18 s gap between Killing and Scheduled in events points to that, which it did not conclude). It correctly listed who/what removed the pod and the exact enqueue failure mechanism as unverified. K8s event evidence appears only in prose, not in samples, as it declared.

investigation_window_note: started_at is ~10 min before the fault (after incident 2 had recovered), ended_at is after the alert resolved; samples must fall inside this window (verify.py:618).
rca_method: Independent subagent with no session context and no knowledge of the injected fault; Prometheus MCP + Kubernetes MCP; samples verbatim from scripts/chaos/harvest-samples.py; prompt: observability/rca-prompt.md. hypotheses/ruled_out/samples are unedited subagent output (written in Vietnamese without diacritics).
